import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from parallel_linear import *
def run(rank, ws):
    os.environ["MASTER_ADDR"]="127.0.0.1"; os.environ["MASTER_PORT"]=str(29600+ws)
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    W = torch.randn(8, 12); x = torch.randn(3, 12, requires_grad=True)
    ref = torch.nn.Linear(12, 8); ref.weight.data.copy_(W); ref.bias.data.zero_()
    y_ref = ref(x); y_ref.sum().backward(); gx_ref = x.grad.clone(); x.grad=None
    for cls in (ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear):
        m = cls(12, 8, True, W); y = m(x); y.sum().backward()
        assert torch.allclose(y, y_ref, atol=1e-5), cls
        assert torch.allclose(x.grad, gx_ref, atol=1e-5), cls
        if cls is ColumnParallelLinear:
            c=8//ws; assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad, ref.weight.grad[rank*c:(rank+1)*c]); assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad, ref.bias.grad[rank*c:(rank+1)*c])
        else:
            c=12//ws; assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad, ref.weight.grad[:, rank*c:(rank+1)*c]); assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad, ref.bias.grad)
        x.grad=None
    if rank==0: print("ok", ws)
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=="__main__":
    for ws in (1,2,4): mp.spawn(run, args=(ws,), nprocs=ws)
